meta.description: Tests verification and documentation after remediation.

question.text: A technician fixes intermittent connectivity by replacing a damaged patch cable. What should happen next before closing the ticket?
options: Verify normal operation and document the cause, solution, and relevant findings
Assume the issue is resolved and discard all notes
Make additional unrelated changes to the switch
correctAnswers: Verify normal operation and document the cause, solution, and relevant findings
